description: Elections Commission - Vacated his Office by a member of the Colombo Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of the Colombo Municipal Council due to ceasing membership in a political party (United Peace Alliance). The notice is issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance by the Returning Officer. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of an elected official, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
